item.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro
item.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro is Google’s flagship coding and reasoning model — Gemini 3.5 Pro hasn’t shipped yet, so 3.1 Pro remains the top tier of the Gemini line for complex, multi-step work.

item.title: MiniMax M3
item.description: MiniMax M3 is Shanghai-based MiniMax’s frontier open-weight release, combining a 1M-token context window with native multimodal input — text, image, and video — aimed at full-repository code understanding rather than file-by-file work.
